app.already_running: nd104-sync is already running – see the tray icon.
notify.locked_body: nd104-sync stopped sending: {reason}. Re-plug the keyboard or use "Check keyboard again".
notify.compatible_body: {model} runs firmware {firmware}, which has not been verified yet. nd104-sync keeps working as long as all protocol checks pass.
ui.preview.caption: Live preview of the keyboard display (last values sent)
ui.dash.connect_hint: Connect the ND104 with a USB cable. Wireless modes are not supported.
ui.weather.name: Name
ui.weather.privacy: Your location is stored only in your local configuration file.
ui.weather.unit_hint: The keyboard display shows the unit of its firmware variant.
ui.weather.manual_hint: Manual / Test sends the values below instead of real weather.
ui.weather.test_hint: Fetches the weather with these settings; nothing is sent to the keyboard.
ui.clock.no_dst: none (fixed mode or zone without DST)
ui.clock.src_system_desc: PC time in the PC time zone
ui.clock.src_timezone_desc: PC time in a chosen time zone
ui.clock.src_ntp_desc: Exact time from a time server
ui.clock.src_manual_desc: PC time plus a fixed offset
ui.clock.ntp_ok: Server reachable – offset to the PC clock: {ms} ms
ui.clock.dst_hint: Automatic follows the time-zone rules and re-syncs the keyboard exactly at the change.
ui.clock.format_hint: 12/24-hour format is part of the keyboard's screen firmware variant.
ui.device.wired_notice: nd104-sync only works with the keyboard connected by USB cable. 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth are not supported.
ui.device.verified_text: This firmware has been verified with nd104-sync.
ui.device.compatible_text: This firmware has not been verified yet. nd104-sync keeps working as long as every protocol check passes and stops immediately otherwise.
ui.device.locked_text: Nothing is sent to the keyboard. Re-plug it or use "Check keyboard again". If it stays locked, please report it with the log file.
ui.device.firmware_update_hint: Compared with the version list in the nd104-sync repository (updated after Chilkey publishes new firmware).
ui.device.poll: Check for the keyboard every … seconds
ui.general.tagline: Time and weather for the Chilkey ND104 display
ui.general.disclaimer: Unofficial project, not affiliated with Chilkey. MIT licence.
ui.err.fallback_same: Choose a different provider than the main one.
ui.err.interval_positive: A whole number of at least 1.
ui.key.title: API key – {provider}
ui.key.placeholder_replace: Paste a new key to replace the stored one
ui.key.saved: Key stored – the weather is fetched again.
ui.key.hint: Stored in the Windows Credential Manager, never in the config file or the log. Saved immediately – no Apply needed.
ui.key.missing_notice: This provider needs an API key. Without it, no weather is fetched (or the fallback provider is used).
ui.coverage.germany: Coverage: Germany and nearby (data of the German weather service DWD)
notify.firmware_body: New firmware for {model}: {parts}. nd104-sync never flashes firmware – see Settings → Device & Firmware for the download and Chilkey's instructions.
notify.firmware_ok_body: The keyboard firmware matches the newest version in the list.
ui.fw.never_flash: nd104-sync never flashes firmware. Update with Chilkey's tools if you want to; afterwards nd104-sync checks the new firmware automatically (verified or compatible).
ui.fw.unknown_hint: The display variant could not be recognised, so its firmware cannot be compared with the list.
